L31·N3175unmasked layer
Largely a context-level neuron: it fires diffusely across casual user-generated comment/review prose, peaking on ordinary mid-sentence continuation words ("this", "that", "then", "all", "member", "fantastic") rather than on a specific form, and is strongly suppressed at paragraph-initial words that open a new rhetorical question in polished expository writing ("How do you…", "In each conversation…").
